name: openworkgraph-local
description: Connect Claude Desktop to the compact local OpenWorkGraph context surface.
long_description: Uses the OpenWorkGraph installation already running on this computer. v0.114 adds configurable browser-context privacy profiles and allowlisted business-object references: Privacy-first keeps references off and more aggressively masks known SaaS object IDs in stored paths; Context correlates repeated work with installation-keyed local tokens without retaining provider IDs; Rich enterprise explicitly opts into minimal validated locators that an authorized connector can resolve. Browser-side durable fingerprints and database-side correlation tokens are independently HMAC-keyed, and full URLs, query values, fragments, typed text, clipboard contents and page contents remain outside this feature. v0.113 improves how connected AI interprets workflow evidence for modern automation: compact rows retain protected work-surface/title identity, missing historical payload is explicitly separated from future automation feasibility, agent-heavy workflows are analyzed for the next human autonomy boundary, redundant steps are treated as hypotheses that require downstream-dependency checks, capability claims are mapped to confirmed/testable/blocked operations, and autonomy is consequence-aware rather than uniformly conservative or aggressive. A fixed evaluation corpus scores both automation underestimation and overreach. v0.112 hardens connected-AI answer accuracy: Claude hook and transcript observations share opaque execution/tool identities, test results distinguish passing/failing/unknown, token usage is explicitly observed or not observed and is never estimated, workflow traces are compact by default with rich detail available on request, work profiles can fall back to authorized local-today history after restart, repeated workflows expose readable steps and foreground-duration fallback, and native-session scan errors report only real bounded failures. v0.111 adds opt-in provenance-safe Working Detail for agent continuity: workspace-relative files, structured command/test facts, repository state and bounded redacted error facts can enrich the existing grounded handoff without storing raw tool output or hidden reasoning; historical import is explicit and AI read permission remains separate. v0.110 makes the compact MCP initialize with evidence-first, full-period paging and current-agent automation guidance; it ships the frontier-aware automation prompt/resource, adds a packaged MCPB smoke check, and gives genuinely undecided new users a local-only 7-day history grace period without granting saved-history AI access. Canonical workflow evidence remains primary; automation judgments remain derived and disposable. The legacy 24-tool MCP entrypoint remains available for existing configurations while new connections use this compact surface.

tools.name: get_current_work_context
tools.description: Read an optional compact derived overview with pointers to canonical evidence.

tools.name: get_context_pulse
tools.description: Read what changed since the last check plus new or materially changed factual findings; pass the returned cursor back next time.

tools.name: list_history
tools.description: Navigate retained human and agent sessions within the saved-history date range the user explicitly allowed.

tools.name: search_work
tools.description: Search prior work through evidence or semantic layers.

tools.name: get_workflow_trace
tools.description: Read the primary canonical paginated workflow evidence, compact by default with rich authorized detail available on request.

tools.name: get_work_profile
tools.description: Read derived workflow signals without productivity scoring, with an authorized local-today fallback after restart.

tools.name: find_repeated_workflows
tools.description: Find readable repeated-work candidates and exact procedural-memory family keys for follow-up.

tools.name: get_task_context
tools.description: Read a bounded task-context bundle with provenance and authority separation.

tools.name: how_did_similar_runs_go
tools.description: Read descriptive prior-run feedback with privacy-safe human step labels, failure points, approval hotspots and observed next steps.

tools.name: get_agent_runs
tools.description: List privacy-safe structural agent runs with explicit test and token-observability semantics.

tools.name: get_agent_handoff
tools.description: Read a grounded prior-agent handoff: canonical structural execution plus separately permitted provenance-safe Working Detail and visible messages.

tools.name: get_playbooks
tools.description: Read shared content-free playbooks (how a kind of work usually went); own workflows need saved-history access.
